title: A scene transport for the About deck: stop-all, step and scrub beats
deviations_from_card: Write set grew by perf-budget.json only (shared surface, committed alone under the lock: app/page.tsx +1 module / +19 KB, my measured share). Card acceptance 8 of 8 is covered by 16 cases: 10 in transport.test.ts (cases 1-7 plus 6b chosen-beat survives stopAll / late chapter joins stopped, 6c tick only advances in autoplay), 2 new clock.test.ts cases (four-term truth table, stop veto), 3 source pins in scene-status.test.ts (transport outside the live region; buttons + range labelled from about.transport.*, no aria-live, no onKeyDown; AboutTab stop-all through createDeckTransport + loadDeckStop). 15 were red before (the 16th, the clock 'ticks only when...' case, was pre-existing and stays green). Design choices beyond the card: TransportState carries `held` (a beat the reader chose) so a deck-wide stop pins each chapter's STILL frame (the reduced-motion frame) instead of beat 0, while a chapter the reader already stepped keeps its beat; play() resumes from the beat on screen. Under OS reduced motion the Play button and the header stop-all are hidden (they would do nothing); step and scrub remain. The rewind-on-entry moved from the render-time previous-state pattern to a useLayoutEffect because the tick now lives in an external store (still lands before paint). Doc and catalogs committed alone under the lock before the code commits, as the brief orders; slot A's sceneAt/STATUS_BEATS are untouched (the scrubber reads CYCLE through the bound clock, not named beats).
